shared_style_prompt: Hand-drawn desi storybook illustration matching the accepted main-kar-lungi style. Warm off-white paper, loose imperfect black ink linework, matte muted color, simple flat watercolor, ordinary daily-life body language, generous breathing room, and small realistic human eyes. Avoid polished romantic editorial watercolor, glossy AI finish, anime/webtoon faces, doll-like faces, poster-card design, and decorative clutter. Exact slide text must be baked into the artwork as simple readable dark-charcoal handwritten lettering. No extra words anywhere except the approved slide text and an optional tiny low-contrast @a.storyof.two brandmark.
identity_lock: Use identity_images/aachu_zuv.png as the primary identity anchor. Aachu/Anchal: long dark hair, soft oval face, warm smile, fair-medium warm skin, white wrap shirt and blue jeans when useful. Zuv/Himanshu: dark wavy hair, thick brows, trimmed beard and mustache, broader build, warm brown skin, pale blue shirt and loose grey pants when useful. negative_prompt: Do not make her nagging, him useless, or either person mean. No date-night glam, no dance-floor/function setting, no couch-only romance, no hand-dragging, no moral quote-card, no 'love is compromise', no polished editorial illustration, no random lettering, no prop text, no wall signs, no frame text, no misspelled slide text, no extra limbs, no distorted hands, no generic Indian stock couple.

Zuv appears at the doorway with one sneaker on and one home slipper still on, sleepy and sheepish in pale blue shirt and loose grey pants; Aachu notices with keys in hand and laughs affectionately.
They sit on building stairs or a tiny gate-side bench; Aachu has outside air, Zuv still has almost-home posture, shoes and slippers visible.
They sit close on stairs or a small bench near the building gate, she happy beside him, he sleepy but satisfied, open building door behind them.
